paragraphs.source_en: Scientists still haven't figured out what happens at the very center of a black hole. Some have suggested that a black hole's center is where time comes to an end while others have proposed that it's a portal to another universe. Finding the definitive answer is widely recognized as one of the great remaining challenges in our continuing quest to understand space, time, and the cosmos.
